data.body: **[P2] Track accepted updates for the resumed invocation.** Updates are still applied with `withinCheckpoint=true`, but when this branch omits the token the SDK discards the response state. On resume, the persisted operation ID is therefore absent from `updatedOperationIds`, causing replay to skip `onOperationEnd` and omit the result/error from `InvocationInfo.updatedOperations`. Record submitted IDs for the next invocation whenever the generated response is tokenless, and add a pause/resume plugin lifecycle test.
